title: Debug logging in production request paths
summary: Flask handlers emit verbose logs or full payloads for every request.
rationale: High-volume logging increases CPU, storage, network egress, and observability cost.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Reduce log volume, sample noisy paths, avoid full payload logging, and apply retention controls.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
